items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The edits are minimal and readable. The nested .get('database', ...get('db', NAME)) matches the existing password/passwd chain. Keeping the local name `db` is fine. The only nit is a stray trailing blank line at the end of the new test in tests/backends/mysql/tests.py.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Two small local edits that follow the existing fallback pattern. No new helpers, no duplicated logic and no dead code. The new tests are focused.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: No new error paths or magic constants. Each kwarg is still added only when its setting is truthy (`if settings_dict['NAME']:`), the same as before.

items.name: Connection kwargs use non-deprecated names
items.name_zh: 连接参数改用非弃用名称
items.evidence: base.py: `kwargs['database'] = settings_dict['NAME']` and `kwargs['password'] = settings_dict['PASSWORD']`. Nothing else in the kwargs building changed.

items.name: Deprecated OPTIONS keys remain supported
items.name_zh: 弃用的 OPTIONS 键仍被兼容
items.evidence: client.py still falls back from 'database' to 'db' to NAME, and the 'passwd' fallback is untouched. OPTIONS are still passed through to the connection kwargs unchanged. The mysqlclient minimum version is not changed and no warnings were added.

validity_flags.basis: skip/xfail marker added to existing tests in tests/backends/mysql/tests.py: "@unittest.skipUnless(connection.vendor == 'mysql', 'MySQL tests')"
